assertions.assertion: The member has a known diagnosis of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The member presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The symptoms are concerning for underlying arrhythmia
A long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring study is indicated
The study is to correlate symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances
The study is to evaluate for potential atrial fibrillation or other dysrhythmias
The denial is under Reason Code PR-204
